title: chore: add Discord production secrets
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the Discord OAuth client and bot bindings to the SOPS-encrypted production Enter configuration
- Reuses the existing staging Discord application credentials
- Enables production Discord account connection after merge and the production secret-sync deployment

gist.headline: The hive joins Discord
gist.blurb: Polli found the production Discord keys and put them somewhere suitably encrypted. Discord account connections can now bloom in the real hive.
gist.summary: Added Discord OAuth client and bot bindings to Enter's SOPS-encrypted production configuration, enabling Discord account connection once the production secret sync deploys.
gist.impact: Users will be able to connect their Discord accounts in production, using the existing Discord application setup.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Discord account linking as a friendly bridge between a cozy retro terminal and a small Discord-style chat window, with Polli carefully carrying a tiny key toward the connection. Use encrypted-lock and blooming code-plant symbols to convey securely activating the production integration.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny sysadmin keyring, connecting a glowing retro terminal to a friendly purple chat-window icon across a garden bridge; a small lock and code-plants bloom beside the connection. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel text: 'CONNECTED'.
